verdict.rationale: A terminal app could plausibly ship git tooling such as `git log --graph`, so this axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions git, commit history, or branch graph visualization. The listed commands (ios_system, pkg packages such as zip and ffmpeg, Python, Lua, C, TeX) do not include any git capability.
